arguments.title: Mask-Free Video Instance Segmentation
key_claims: Temporal KNN patch correspondences provide mask-consistency supervision with zero, one or several matches, handling ambiguous/no correspondences better than an unconditional one-to-one assumption. Mask-free does not mean annotation-free: the system uses bounding boxes. Its consistency idea motivates a diagnostic only; training a new segmentation model is outside the first pilot. Appearance changes and repeated graphics can invalidate correspondences, so independent foreground masks and retained-background color error remain necessary.
